auth.activate.rejected: The activation code is invalid or has expired. Contact HR for a new code.
auth.activate.tokenDescription: Filled in for you when you open the activation link.
auth.activate.tokenInvalid: The activation code is not in the expected format

home.title: Overview
home.accountReadyBody: Requests, annual leave and timesheets will appear here once HR links your employee profile.
home.rolesBody: The menu on the left shows only the features you have been granted. If something you need is missing, contact HR.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This link does not exist or you are not allowed to view this page.
locale.label: Language
hr.write.deniedBody: Changes to identity data, leave rates, team assignments and the work calendar need two-step verification within the last 5 minutes. Set up two-step verification on the Sign-in methods page, then try again. If it still fails, you do not have permission — contact HR.
hr.write.unknown: The outcome is unknown because the connection failed. Reload the page to check before trying again.
hr.write.conflict: The information duplicates another record, no longer fits the current state or was just changed by someone else. Reload the page, check and try again.
employee.list.title: Employees
employee.list.description: Employees you are allowed to see.
employee.create.title: Add an employee profile
employee.edit.title: Edit basic information
employee.field.codeHint: Letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; up to 32 characters.
employee.field.annualLeaveHint: At least 12 days, in steps of 0.25 day.
employee.form.codeInvalid: Use letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen (up to 32 characters).
employee.form.documentNumberInvalid: The document number has 6–20 capital letters or digits.
employee.form.documentPair: Fill in both the document type and number, or leave both empty.
employee.form.taxCodeInvalid: The tax code has 10–13 digits, optionally followed by "-" and 3 digits.
employee.form.leaveDaysInvalid: Annual leave is 12 to 366 days, in steps of 0.25 day.
employee.profile.title: Basic information
employee.profile.untilHint: Each period ends the day before the date in the last column.
employee.status.effectiveOnHint: From this day the employee is permanent; before it, still on probation.
employee.status.terminatedOnHint: The last day the employee works. This cannot be undone here.
employee.identity.title: Identity information
employee.identity.optionalHint: Can be added later. Only the employee and HR can see it.
employee.identity.freshHint: Saving identity information needs a sign-in from the last 5 minutes.
employee.leaveRate.title: Annual leave rate
employee.leaveRate.addHint: The new rate applies from its effective date; earlier rates stay in the history.
employee.account.title: Sign-in account
employee.account.hint: Link the profile to an account whose email was added. You cannot link your own account.
team.title: Teams
team.description: Teams you belong to or may see, with their lead and members.
team.field.name: Team name
team.lead.title: Team lead (first approval)
team.member.title: Members
team.member.empty: The team has no members yet.
team.member.primaryHint: Each employee has exactly one primary team (the first team always is). A primary team can only be removed when it is the last one.
account.title: Sign-in methods
account.intro: Your email, the Google account you sign in with and your two-step verification.
account.summary.title: Your account
account.google.title: Google account
account.google.change: Each HRM account uses exactly one Google account. To switch to another Google account, contact your system administrator.
error.invalidRequest: The submitted information is not valid. Please check it and try again.
error.authenticationFailed: Your session is invalid or has expired. Please sign in again.
error.accessDenied: This action could not be completed. Reload the page or contact HR.
error.conflict: The data has just changed. Please reload and try again.
error.unavailable: The system is temporarily not responding. Please try again later.
hr.write.deniedBodyMfa: Changes to identity data, leave rates, team assignments and the work calendar need two-step verification within the last 5 minutes. Enter your code, then try again. If it still fails, you do not have permission — contact HR.
mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: A 6-digit code from an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator) confirms important actions.
mfa.setup.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key below.
mfa.setup.qr: QR code to add HRM to your authenticator app
mfa.setup.codeHint: Enter the code your app shows. The setup expires after 15 minutes.
mfa.setup.otherSessions: Once it is on, your other signed-in sessions are signed out.
mfa.setup.failedTitle: Two-step verification is not on yet
mfa.setup.rejected: The code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and enter a new code.
mfa.setup.expired: The setup expired or was finished elsewhere. Start again.
mfa.codes.title: Recovery codes
mfa.codes.body: Each code works once, for when you do not have your phone. They are shown only now — keep them somewhere safe.
mfa.remove.title: Turn off two-step verification?
mfa.remove.body: The app code and every recovery code stop working, and your other sessions are signed out. You cannot do important actions until you set it up again. This needs two-step verification within the last 5 minutes.
mfa.stepUp.title: Enter your verification code
mfa.stepUp.body: This action needs verification within the last 5 minutes. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.stepUp.recoveryBody: Enter one recovery code. A used code cannot be used again.
mfa.stepUp.rejected: The code is not valid or was already used. Too many wrong codes in a row sign you out everywhere.
mfa.stepUp.notEnabled: Two-step verification is not on for this account.
mfa.stepUp.done: Verified. Repeat the action within 5 minutes.
mfa.invalidRecovery: A recovery code has 16 characters: letters A–Z and digits 2–7.
calendar.title: Work calendar
calendar.description: Standard working hours and public holidays with full pay.
calendar.standard.title: Standard working hours
calendar.standard.rest: The 13:00–14:00 lunch break is not working time. Saturday and Sunday are weekly days off.
calendar.holidays.title: Paid public holidays
calendar.holidays.empty: No public holiday in this year yet.
calendar.holidays.name: Holiday name
calendar.holidays.addHint: Enter the dates from the official public holiday announcement for the year. Each change creates a new calendar version.
calendar.form.dateInvalid: Enter a valid date as dd/mm/yyyy.
calendar.form.weekend: Holidays can only be set on Monday to Friday.
calendar.form.nameRequired: Enter the holiday name (up to 200 characters).
